Sikh religious body orders Punjab lawmakers to address sacrilege law concerns

The Akal Takht, a prominent Sikh religious authority, has summoned Punjab lawmakers, including the Chief Minister, to address concerns regarding the 'Jagroop Singh Guru Granth Sahib Satkar (Amendment) Act-2026'. The religious body has directed the legislators to resolve all objections to the law within 30 days, with the lawmakers assuring compliance with the Akal Takht's directives.
